page.layout: One printed page, a title page: the central title in two lines of italic type, in the middle of the page. Above it a faint, largely illegible title block and below it a publisher's imprint in small type, which is not legible on the scan.
page.notes: The faint text above the central title and the small imprint lines at the foot of the page are too faded to read, so they are not transcribed. The scan also shows a circular library stamp at the left and a handwritten mark at the lower right, which are excluded. The lines above the title are only ghosted impressions. Both main title lines are read from the scan with confidence; the long s appears as a plain s in the title as printed ("impressum", "Ecclesiasticos").
